title: The Love-chase
author: James Sheridan Knowles
description: "The Love-chase" by James Sheridan Knowles is a play written in the mid-19th century, specifically set in a contemporary London.
longDescription: The story revolves around the intricate relationships of various characters involved in love pursuits, notably Sir William Fondlove, his daughter Constance, and a host of suitors, including the jovial Master Waller and the sportsman Master Wildrake.

authorInfo.bio: James Sheridan Knowles (1784–1862) wrote The Love-chase. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
